objective: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.

description: Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire.  They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.
I don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good!  Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
progress: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
completion: Back with some bandanas, I see. The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
